footer.description: On-demand roadside assistance for two-wheelers and four-wheelers. Fixed prices, live tracking, and verified mechanics in Kalyani, West Bengal.
footer.copyright: © 2026 FixOnRoad. Made with ❤️ in West Bengal.

step1.title: Pin Your Location
step1.desc: Instant auto-detection or manual landmark selection in Kalyani / West Bengal.

step2.title: Select Issue & Get Price
step2.desc: Choose flat tire, jump start, chain, or towing. Transparent upfront pricing with no hidden charges.

step3.title: Mechanic Dispatched
step3.desc: Live GPS tracking as your verified technician arrives in minutes with the right tools.

step4.title: Pay Digitally or Cash
step4.desc: Inspect the fix and pay seamlessly via UPI (GPay/PhonePe/Paytm) or cash.

hero.titleTag: FixOnRoad — On-Demand Roadside Help for Bikes & Cars
hero.subheading: Stranded on your vehicle? Request a verified mechanic instantly. Fixed pricing, live tracking, and fast response times.

triage.subheading: Select your issue for transparent, fixed pricing and instant mechanic dispatch.

pricing.title: Fixed Transparent Pricing
pricing.desc: Starting at ₹150. Know the exact cost before confirming the request. No haggling on the roadside.

gps.title: Real-time GPS Tracking
gps.desc: Watch your assigned mechanic travel to your exact location on a live map with precise ETAs.

payment.title: Instant UPI / Cash
payment.desc: Pay seamlessly through the app via UPI, card, or hand cash directly to the mechanic after the job is done.

mechanics.desc: Every mechanic on FixOnRoad is background-verified, rated by real riders, and equipped to handle bike emergencies on the spot.

mechanicLanding.titleTag: Partner With FixOnRoad — Earn on Your Schedule in West Bengal
mechanicLanding.subheading: Customers find you. Prices are pre-agreed. You show up, fix, and get paid instantly. Zero commission for the first 6 months.

benefits.subheading: We built FixOnRoad to solve every pain-point local mechanics face daily.

item1.title: No Wasted Trips
item1.desc: Get accurate GPS pins. You only travel when you accept a job near you. See distance and ETA before accepting.

item2.title: Fixed Pricing, No Haggling
item2.desc: Customers accept the price before booking. No bargaining at the roadside. Your rate = your earnings.

item3.title: Instant Secure Payouts
item3.desc: Instant daily settlements directly via UPI (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm) or direct bank transfer. Zero hold time.

item4.title: Zero Commission (Launch)
item4.desc: Keep 100% of every rupee during our launch phase. No hidden fees. No platform deductions.

item5.title: Build Your Reputation
item5.desc: Every 5-star review builds your profile. Top mechanics get priority in job dispatch.

item6.title: Grow Your Business
item6.desc: Track your earnings, completion rate, and customer feedback in a simple dashboard.

item1.title: Sign Up Free
item1.desc: Register with your phone number. Choose your focus: Two-Wheeler Specialist, Car & EV Specialist, or Multi-Vehicle Technician. Upload Aadhaar/PAN for verification. Takes 2 minutes.

item2.title: Go Online
item2.desc: Toggle your status to "Online" when ready. You'll receive jobs within your radius.

item3.title: Fix & Earn
item3.desc: Accept a job, ride to the pin, fix the vehicle (bike or car), get paid. It's that simple.

cta.desc: Join 500+ mechanics already earning with FixOnRoad. Registration is free and takes 2 minutes.
